title: Dominant button press dispatch (_on_dominant_pressed) has zero test coverage
evidence:
var action := FinLitTouchTargets.dominant_action(_state)
	match action["action"]:
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_FIND_WORK:
			_show_job_picker()
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_FIX:
			_do_repair(action["asset_id"])
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_BUY:
			_show_buy_sheet()
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_UPGRADE:
			_do_upgrade(action["asset_id"])
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_WORK_SHIFT:
			if _shift_ready():
				_last_shift_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				_pay_wage()
--- scene test exercises ONLY the label path, never the press ---
	_street._refresh_dominant_button()
	check(dominant.text.contains("FIX"), "damaged asset puts FIX ahead of BUY (label %s)" % dominant.text)
	_street._state["assets"][0]["damaged"] = false
	_street._refresh_dominant_button()
	check(dominant.text.contains("BUY"), "no damage + affordable plot -> BUY (label %s)" % dominant.text)
	_street._state["job"] = ""
	_street._refresh_dominant_button()
	check(dominant.text.contains("FIND WORK"), "unemployed prefix wins over everything (label %s)" % dominant.text)
--- grep of test_economy.gd for _on_dominant_pressed/_do_repair/_do_upgrade/_show_job_picker/_show_buy_sheet/_pay_wage: no matches (exit 1) ---
detail: AC3 claims text, enabled, AND press dispatch share one source. Only the label path (_refresh_dominant_button) is scene-tested; _on_dominant_pressed and its handlers are never invoked, so a match-arm typo routes a press to the wrong action uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a scene test that calls _on_dominant_pressed() for each dominant_action arm and asserts the right handler fires: job picker shown, asset repaired, buy sheet shown, upgrade applied, wage paid.

title: Missing-id defensive guard in dominant_action is never exercised
detail: Both rules loops use .get("id", -1) defensively but no test passes an asset missing the id key; the asset_id < 0 skip branch is never exercised.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test feeding dominant_action a damaged and an upgradeable asset dict without id; assert each is skipped with no crash and no wrong selection.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: dominant_action, modal interplay, touch floors, and proxy z-order tap delivery are all pinned. P1 ≈86%: the dominant button's press dispatch (_on_dominant_pressed) has no test — only labels are asserted. Overall ≈92%.
recommended_fix: Pin the dominant button's press dispatch end-to-end (one tap per dominant_action arm → correct handler fires) to lift P1 to ≥90% and clear the gate to PASS.
